profile.headline: Software Engineer, Web Developer, Network and Systems Administrator, and cat parent. Enthusiast of good food, drink, the arts, and technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of a FastAPI-based data catalog façade microservice to AWS ECS via Terraform.
Innovating and improving application performance, reliability, scalability, security, and observability by advocating and implementing asynchronous code patterns, connection pooling, error handling, distributed data pipelines, RBAC via OIDC, and structured logging.
Transforming rapidly evolving agentic workflow product requirements into development tasks.
Implementing modular and reusable code patterns across UI (React/JavaScript) and backend (FastAPI/Python) projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · PostgreSQL · Agentic Workflows · Amazon ECS · Amazon SQS · Terraform · FastAPI

positions.title: Engineer II, Software Development
positions.description:
Analyzed, designed, implemented, tested, deployed, maintained, and provided support for multi-node, Spring-based web applications for Comcast customer IAM.
Configured and deployed infrastructure and applications to AWS using Terraform.
Automated end-to-end testing with Neodymium and performance testing with Gatling.
Utilized Jenkins and GitHub Actions for automating CI/CD pipelines including PR builds and tests, application releases, container publishing, and deployments.
Lead efforts in improving front-end development best practices on the team including modernization, modularization, package releases, bundling application code and stylesheets, linting, and testing.
Key engineer in designing and implementing an OAuth 2.0 Step Up Authentication Challenge PDP API with an external PIP integration.
Created and monitored data visualizations in Splunk, ELK, and AWS CloudWatch to assess the health of deployed applications.
Researched improvements for current system architecture to increase performance and reduce costs.
Raised awareness toward potential issues including bugs, privacy, security, accessibility, ease of use, and maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · TypeScript · Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Web Applications · JavaScript · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · OAuth · Web Services API · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Splunk · Elastic Stack (ELK) · Amazon CloudWatch · Amazon ECS · AWS Lambda · Amazon CloudFront · Amazon EC2 · Amazon Route 53 · AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM) · Elastic Load Balancing · Jenkins · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Writing maintainable code and tests in JavaScript, the React Native framework, and Node. As a previously iOS-only application, wrote code in Swift.
Using Google Firebase as a serverless mobile development platform for authentication, database, and file-storage requirements.
Documenting requirements, components, classes, and tests.
Planning software engineering and development tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · React Native · Firebase · Software Architectural Design · Mobile Application Development · TypeScript · JavaScript · Node.js · Software Documentation

positions.title: Product Management Intern
positions.description:
Reviewed the current VPower system architecture with lead developers and offered suggestions for improvement.
Documented product requirements and workflows for internal processes using UML diagrams.
Researched external products, including notification systems, CRMs, and cloud computing options, as solutions to unique business requirements.
Utilized Google Analytics to create reports on VPower product usage.
Wrote Python scripts to analyze large-volume experimental battery storage statistics.

positions.title: Measurement Analyst Assistant, Co-op
positions.description:
Created a prototype for testing research software to categorize key phrases in test answers and consolidate multiple user responses using Microsoft Access and VBA.
Completed a prototype for automating a research process by creating a report in PowerPoint presentation format using Microsoft Access and VBA.
Created spreadsheets for analyzing a live database using Microsoft Excel and PowerPivot.

positions.title: Development & Integration Services, Co-op
positions.description:
Developed and tested the back-end of eDatafeed and Data Viewer web applications using J2EE and Oracle Database on a Spring framework.
Fixed front-end UI bugs of eDatafeed and Data Viewer using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Collaborated in an agile environment with other developers and business units to define requirements and priorities.
Utilized Atlassian Jira and Confluence for issue tracking and product documentation.
